text.body: prameyaratnāvalī baladevavidyābhūṣaṇapraṇītā bhagavatpāratamyam jayati śrīgovindo gopīnāthaḥ samadanagopāla | vakṣyāmi yasya kṛpayā prameyaratnāvalīṃ sūkṣmām ||1|| bhaktiābhāsenāpi toṣaṃ dadhāne dharmādhyakṣe viśvanistāritanāmni nityānandādvaitacaitanyarūpe tattve tasminnityamāstāṃ ratirnaḥ ||2|| ānandatīrthanāmā sukhamayadhāmā yatirjīyāta| saṃsārārṇavataraṇiṃ yamiha janāḥ kīrtayanti budhāḥ ||3|| bhavati vicintyā viduṣāṃ niravakarā guruparamparā nityam | ekāntitvaṃ siddhyati yayodayati yena haritoṣaḥ ||4|| yaduktaṃ padmapurāṇe -- sampradāyavihīnā ye mantrāste niṣphalā matāḥ | ataḥ kalau bhaviṣyanti catvāraḥ sampradāyinaḥ śrībrahmarudrasanakāḥ vaiṣṇavāḥ kṣitipāvanāḥ catvāraste kalau bhāvyā hyutkale puruṣottamāta||ka|| rāmānujaṃ śrīḥ svīcakre madhvācāryaṃ caturmukhaḥ śrīviṣṇusvāminaṃ rudro nimbādityaṃ catuḥsanaḥ ||kha|| tatra svaguruparamparā, yathā -- śrīkṛṣṇabrahmadevarṣibādarāyaṇasaṃjñakān śrīmādhvaśrīpadmanābhaśrīmannaraharimādhavān akṣobhyajayatīrthajñānasindhudayānidhīn śrīvidyānidhirājendrajayadharmānkramādvayam puruṣottamabrahmaṇyavyāsatīrthāṃśca saṃstumaḥ tato lakṣmīpatiṃ mādhavendraṃ ca bhaktitaḥ tacchiṣyānśrīśvarādvaitanityānandānjagadgurūn devamīśvaraśiṣyaṃ śrīcaitanyaṃ ca bhajāmahe śrīkṛṣṇapremadānena yena nistāritaṃ jagata||ga|| atha prameyāṇyuddiśyante -- śrīmadhvaḥ prāha viṣṇuṃ paratamamakhilāmnāyavedyaṃ ca viśvaṃ satyaṃ bhedaṃ ca jīvānharicaraṇajuṣastāratamyaṃ ca teṣām | mokṣaṃ viṣṇvaṅghrilābhaṃ tadamalabhajanaṃ tasya hetuṃ pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣāditrayaṃ cetyupadiśati hariḥ kṛṣṇacaitanyacandraḥ ||5|| tasya śrīviṣṇoḥ paratamatvaṃ, yathā śrīgopālopaniṣadi -- tasmātkṛṣṇa eva paro devastaṃ dhyāyettaṃ rasettaṃ bhajettaṃ yajeta|| iti || || śvetāśvataropaniṣadi ca -- jñātvā devaṃ sarvapāśāpahāniḥ kṣīṇaiḥ kleśairjanmamṛtyuprahāṇiḥ tasyābhidhyānāttṛtīyaṃ dehabhede viśvaiśvaryaṃ kevala āptakāmaḥ || || iti | etajjñeyaṃ nityamevātmasaṃsthaṃ nātaḥ paraṃ veditavyaṃ hi kiñcita|| iti ca | śrīgītāsu ca -- mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiṃ cidasti dhanaṃjaya mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva ||iti|| hetutvādvibhucaitanyānandatvādiguṇāśrayāta| nityalakṣmyādimatvācca kṛṣṇaḥ paratamo mataḥ ||6|| tatra sarvahetutvaṃ yathāhuḥ śvetāśvatarāḥ -- sarvā diśa ūrdhvamadhaśca tiryak prakāśayanbhrājate yadvanaḍvāna| ekaḥ sa devo bhagavānvareṇyo yonisvabhāvānadhitiṣṭhatyekaḥ || iti | yacca svabhāvaṃ pacati viśvayoniḥ pācyāṃśca sarvānpariṇāmayedyaḥ || || vibhucaitanyānandatvaṃ, yathā kāṭhake -- mahāntaṃ vibhumātmānaṃ matvā dhīro na śocati || || vijñānasukharūpatvamātmaśabdena bodhyate | anena muktagamyatvavyūtpatteriti tadvidaḥ || 7 || vājasaneyinaścāhuḥ -- vijñānamānandaṃ brahma rātirdātuḥ parāyaṇam || || śrīgopālopaniṣadi ca -- tamekaṃ govindaṃ saccidānandavigraham || || mūrtatvaṃ pratipattavyaṃ citsukhasyaiva rāgavata| vijñānaghanaśabdādikīrtanāccāpi tasya tata| dehadehibhidā nāstītyetenaivopadarśitam || 8 || mūrtatvasyaiva vibhutvaṃ yathā śvetāśvataropaniṣadi -- vṛkṣa iva stabdho divi tiṣṭhatyekas tenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ puruṣeṇa sarvam || || dyustho'pi nikhilavyāpītyākhyānānmūrtimānvibhuḥ | yugapaddhyātṛvṛndeṣu sākṣātkārācca tādṛśaḥ || 9 || śrīdaśame ca -- na cāntarbahiryasya na pūrvaṃ nāpi cāparam | pūrvāparaṃ bahiścāntarjagato yo jagacca yaḥ || taṃ matvātmajamavyaktaṃ martyaliṅgamadhokṣajam | gopikolūkhale dāmnā babandha prākṛtaṃ yathā || || śrīgītāsu ca -- mayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā | matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ || na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram || || anantyā śaktirastīśe yogaśabdena yocyate | virodhabhañjikā sā syāditi tattvavidāṃ matam || 10 || ādinā sarvajñatvaṃ yathā muṇḍake -- yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavita|| || ānanditvaṃ ca taittirīyake -- ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvānna vibheti kutaścana || || prabhutvasuhṛttvajñānadatvamocakatvāni ca śvetāśvataraśrutau -- sarvasya prabhumīśānaṃ sarvasya śaraṇaṃ suhṛta|| || prajñā ca tasmātprasṛtā purāṇī || || saṃsāramokṣasthitibandhahetuḥ || || mādhuryaṃ ca, śrīgopālopaniṣadi -- satpuṇḍarīkanayanaṃ meghābhaṃ vaidyutāmbaram | dvibhujaṃ jñānamudrāḍhyaṃ vanamālinamīśvaram || || na bhinnā dharmiṇo dharmā bhedabhānaṃ viśeṣataḥ | yasmātkālaḥ sarvadāstītyādidhīrviduṣāmapi || 11 || evamuktaṃ nāradapañcarātre -- nirdoṣapūrṇaguṇavigraha ātmatantro niścetanātmakaśarīraguṇaiśca hīnaḥ | ānandamātrakarapādamukhodarādiḥ sarvatra ca svagatabhedavivarjitātmā || || atha nityalakṣmīkatvaṃ yathā viṣṇupurāṇe -- nityaiva sā jaganmātā viṣṇoḥ śrīranapāyinī | yathā sarvagato viṣṇustathaiveyaṃ dvijottama || || viṣṇoḥ syuḥ śaktayastisrastāsu yā kīrtitā parā | saiva śrīstadabhinneti prāha śiṣyānprabhurmahāna|| 12 || tatra triśaktirviṣṇuḥ, yathā śvetāśvataropaniṣadi -- parāsya śaktirvividhaiva śrūyate svābhāvikī jñānabalakriyā ca || || pradhānakṣetrajñapatirguṇeśaḥ || || śrīviṣṇupurāṇe ca -- viṣṇuśaktiḥ parā proktā kṣetrajñākhyā tathāparā | avidyākarmasaṃjñānyā tṛtīyā śaktiriṣyate || || paraiva viṣṇvabhinnā śrīrityuktaṃ tatraiva -- kalākāṣṭhānimeṣādikālasūtrasya gocare | yasya śaktirna śuddhasya prasīdatu sa no hariḥ || procyate parameśo yaḥ yaḥ śuddho'pyupacārataḥ | prasīdatu sa no viṣṇurātmā yaḥ sarvadehinām || || eṣā paraiva trivṛdityapyuktaṃ, tatraiva -- hlādinī sandhinī saṃvittvayyekā sarvasaṃśraye | hlādatāpakarī miśrā tvayi no guṇavarjite || || eko'pi viṣṇurekāpi lakṣmīstadanapāyinī | svasiddhairbahubhirveśairbahurityabhidhīyate || 13 || tatraikatve satyeva viṣṇorbahutvaṃ, yathā śrīgopālopaniṣadi -- eko vaśī sarvagaḥ kṛṣṇa īḍya eko'pi sanbahudhā yo'vabhāti | taṃ pīṭhasthaṃ ye tu yajanti dhīrās teṣāṃ sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ netareṣām || || atha lakṣmyāstadyathā -- parāsya śaktirvividhaiva śrūyate || || pūrtiḥ sārvatrikī yadyapyaviśeṣā tathāpi hi | tāratamyaṃ ca tacchaktivyaktyavyaktikṛtaṃ bhaveta|| 14 || tatra viṣṇoḥ sārvatrikī pūrtir, yathā vājasaneyake -- pūrṇamadaḥ pūrṇamidaṃ pūrṇātpūrṇamudacyate | pūrṇasya pūrṇamādāya pūrṇamevāvaśiṣyate || || mahāvārāhe ca -- sarve nityāḥ śāśvatāśca dehāstasya parātmanaḥ | hānopādānarahitā naiva prakṛtijāḥ kvacita|| paramānandasandohā jñānamātrāśca sarvataḥ | sarve sarvaguṇaiḥ pūrṇāḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitāḥ || || atha śriyaḥ sā yathā śrīviṣṇupurāṇe -- evaṃ yathā jagatsvāmī devadevo janārdanaḥ | avatāraṃ karotyeṣa tathā śrīstatsahāyinī || punaśca padmādudbhūtā ādityo'bhūdyadā hariḥ | yadā ca bhārgavo rāmastadābhūddharaṇī tviyam || rāghavatve'bhavatsītā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇajanmani | anyeṣu cāvatāreṣu viṣṇoreṣā sahāyinī || devatve devadeheyaṃ manuṣyatve ca mānuṣī | viṣṇordehānurūpāṃ vai karotyeṣātmanastanum || || syātsvarūpasatī pūrtirihaikyāditi vinmatam || 15 || atha tathāpi tāratamyam -- tatra śrīviṣṇostadyathā śrībhāgavate -- ete cāṃśakalāḥ puṃsaḥ kṛṣṇastu bhagavānsvayam || || aṣṭamastu tayorāsītsvayameva hariḥ kila || iti ca || || atha śriyastadyathā puruṣabodhinyāmatharvopaniṣadi -- gokulākhye māthuramaṇḍala ityupakramya dve pārśve candrāvalī rādhikā cetyabhidhāya paratra yasyā aṃśe lakṣmīdurgādikā śaktiriti || || gautamīyatantre ca -- devī kṛṣṇamayī proktā rādhikā paradevatā | sarvalakṣmīmayī sarvakāntiḥ sammohinī parā || || atha nityadhāmatvamādiśabdāt, yathā chāndogye -- sa bhagavaḥ kasminpratiṣṭhita iti | sve mahimnīti || || divye brahmapure hyeṣa saṃvyomnyātmā pratiṣṭhita || iti ca || || ṛkṣu ca -- tā vāṃ vāstūnyuśmasi gamadhyai yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṅgā ayāsaḥ | atrāha tadurugāyasya vṛṣṇaḥ paramaṃ padamavabhāti bhūri || || śrīgopālopaniṣadi ca -- tāsāṃ madhye sākṣādbrahmagopālapurī hi || || jitantestotre ca -- lokaṃ vaikuṇṭhanāmānaṃ divyaṣāḍguṇyasaṃyutam | avaiṣṇavānāmaprāpyaṃ guṇatrayavivarjitam || nityasiddhaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ tanmayaiḥ pāñcakālikaiḥ | sabhāprāsādasaṃyuktaṃ vanaiścopavanaiḥ śubham || vāpīkūpataḍāgaiśca vṛkṣaṣaṇḍaiḥ sumaṇḍitam | aprākṛtaṃ surairvandyamayutārkasamaprabham || iti || || brahmasaṃhitāyāṃ ca -- sahasrapatraṃ kamalaṃ gokulākhyaṃ mahatpadam | tatkarṇikāraṃ taddhāma tadanantāṃśasambhavam || iti || || prapañce svātmakaṃ lokamavatārya maheśvaraḥ | āvirbhavati tatreti mataṃ brahmādiśabdataḥ || 16 || govinde saccidānande naradārakatā yathā | ajñairnirūpyate tadvaddhāmni prākṛtatā kila || 17 || atha nityalīlatvaṃ ca, tathā hi śrutiḥ -- yadgataṃ bhavacca bhaviṣyacca || || eko devo nityalīlānurakto bhaktavyāpī bhaktahṛdyantarātmā || || smṛtiśca -- janma karma ca me divyamevaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ | tyaktvā dehaṃ punarjanma naiti māmeti so'rjuna || || rūpānantyājjanānantyāddhāmānantyācca karma tata| nityaṃ syāttadabhedāccetyuditaṃ tattvavittamaiḥ || 18 || iti prameyaratnāvalyāṃ bhagavatpāratamyaprakaraṇaṃ nāma prathamaprameyaṃ || 1 || athākhilāmnāyavedyatvam yathā śrīgopālopaniṣadi -- yo'sau sarvairvedairgīyate || iti || || kāṭhake ca -- sarve vedā yatpadamāmananti tapāṃsi sarvāṇi ca yadvadanti || iti || || śrīharivaṃśe ca -- vede rāmāyaṇe caiva purāṇe bhārate tathā | ādāvante ca madhye ca hariḥ sarvatra gīyate || iti || || sākṣātparamparābhyāṃ vedā gāyanti mādhavaṃ sarve | vedāntāḥ kila sākṣādapare tebhyaḥ paramparayā || 1 || kvacitkvacidavācyatvaṃ yadvedeṣu vilokyate | kārtsnyena vācyaṃ na bhavediti syāttatra sadgatiḥ | anyathā tu tadārambho vyarthaḥ syāditi me matiḥ || 2 || śabdapravṛttihetūnāṃ jātyādīnāmabhāvataḥ | brahma nirdharmakaṃ vācyaṃ naivetyāhurvipaścitaḥ || 3 || sarvaiḥ śabdairavācye tu lakṣaṇā na bhavedataḥ | lakṣyaṃ ca na bhaveddharmahīnaṃ brahmeti me matam || 4 || iti prameyaratnāvalyāṃ akhilāmnāyavedyatvaprakaraṇaṃ nāma dvitīyaprameyaṃ || 2 || viśvasatyatvam svaśaktyā sṛṣṭavānviṣṇuryathārthaṃ sarvavijjagata| ityukteḥ satyamevaitadvairāgyārthamasadvacaḥ || 1 || tathā hi śvetāśvataropaniṣadi -- ya eko'varṇo bahudhā śaktiyogād varṇānanekānnihitārtho dadhāti || iti || || śrīviṣṇupurāṇe ca -- ekadeśasthitasyāgnerjyotsnā vistāriṇī yathā | parasya brahmaṇaḥ śaktistathedamakhilaṃ jagata|| iti || || īśāvāsyopaniṣadi -- sa paryagācchukramakāyamavraṇam asnāviraṃ śuddhamapāpaviddham | kavirmanīṣī paribhūḥ svayaṃbhūr yāthātathyato'rthānvyadadhācchāśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ || iti || || śrīviṣṇupurāṇe ca -- tadetadakṣayaṃ nityaṃ jaganmunivarākhilam | āvirbhāvatirobhāvajanmanāśavikalpavata|| iti || || mahābhārate ca -- brahma satyaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ caiva prajāpatiḥ | satyādbhūtāni jātāni satyaṃ bhūtamayaṃ jagata|| iti || || ātmā vā idamityādau vanalīnavihaṅgavata| sattvaṃ viśvasya mantavyamityuktaṃ vedavedibhiḥ || 2 || iti prameyaratnāvalyāṃ viśvasatyatvaprakaraṇaṃ nāma tṛtīyaprameyam || 3 || bhedasatyatvam atha viṣṇuto jīvānāṃ bhedaḥ | tathā hi śvetāśvatarāḥ paṭhanti -- dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣaṣvajāte | tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādv attyanaśnannanyo'bhicākaśīti || || samāne vṛkṣe puruṣo nimagno 'nīśayā śocati muhyamānaḥ | juṣṭaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśam asya mahimānamiti vītaśokaḥ || || upakramopasaṃhārāvabhyāso'pūrvatā phalam | arthavādopapattau ca liṅgaṃ tātparyanirṇaye || iti tātparyaliṅgāni ṣaḍyānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ | bhede tāni pratīyante tenāsau tasya gocaraḥ || 1 || kiṃ ca muṇḍake -- yadā paśyaḥ paśyate rukmavarṇaṃ kartāramīśaṃ puruṣaṃ brahmayonim | tadā vidvānpuṇyapāpe vidhūya nirañjanaḥ paramaṃ sāmyamupaiti || || kāṭhake ca -- yathodakaṃ śuddhe śuddhamāsiktaṃ tādṛgeva bhavati | evaṃ munervijānata ātmā bhavati gautama || || śrīgītāsu ca -- idaṃ jñānamupāśritya mama sādharmyamāgatāḥ | sarge'pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca || || eṣu mokṣe'pi bhedokteḥ syādbhedaḥ pāramārthikaḥ | brahmāhameko jīvo'smi nānye jīvā na ceśvaraḥ || 2 || madavidyākalpitāste syuritītthaṃ ca dūṣitam | anyathā nitya ityādiśrutyartho nopapadyate || 3 || tathā hi kaṭhāḥ paṭhanti -- nityo nityānāṃ cetanaścetanānām eko bahūnāṃ yo vidadhāti kāmāna| tamātmasthaṃ ye'nupaśyanti dhīrās teṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām || || ekasmādīśvarānnityāccetanāttādṛśā mithaḥ | bhidyante bahavo jīvāstena bhedaḥ sanātanaḥ || 4 || prāṇaikādhīnavṛttitvādvāgādeḥ prāṇatā yathā | tathā brahmādhīnavṛtterjagato brahmatocyate || 5 || tathā hi chāndogye paṭhyate -- na vai vāco na cakṣūṃṣi na śrotrāṇi na manāṃsītyācakṣate | prāṇa ityevācakṣate prāṇo hyevaitāni sarvāṇi bhavati || || brahmavyāpyatvataḥ kaiścijjagadbrahmeti manyate || 6 || yaduktaṃ śrīviṣṇupurāṇe -- yo'yaṃ tavāgato deva samīpaṃ devatāgaṇaḥ | satyameva jagatsraṣṭā yataḥ sarvagato bhavāna|| || pratibimbaparicchedapakṣau yau svīkṛtau paraiḥ | vibhutvāviṣayatvābhyāṃ tau vidvadbhirnirākṛtau || 7 || advaitaṃ brahmaṇo bhinnamabhinnaṃ vā tvayocyate | ādye dvaitāpatterante siddhasādhanatāśruteḥ || 8 || alīkaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahma pramāṇāviṣayatvataḥ | śraddheyaṃ viduṣāṃ naivetyūcire tattvavādinaḥ || 9 || iti prameyaratnāvalyāṃ bhedasatyatvaprakaraṇaṃ nāma caturthaprameyaṃ || 4 || atha jīvānāṃ bhagavaddāsatvam tathā hi śvetāśvatarāḥ paṭhanti -- tamīśvarāṇāṃ paramaṃ maheśvaraṃ taṃ devatānāṃ paramaṃ ca daivatam | patiṃ patīnāṃ paramaṃ parastād vidāma devaṃ bhuvaneśamīḍyam || || smṛtiśca -- brahmā śambhustathaivārkaścandramāśca śatakratuḥ | evamādyāstathaivānye yuktā vaiṣṇavatejasā || ityādyā || sabrahmakāḥ sarudrāśca sendrā devā maharṣibhiḥ | arcayanti suraśreṣṭhaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim || iti ca || pādme ca jīvalakṣaṇe -- dāsabhūto harereva nānyasyaiva kadācana || || iti prameyaratnāvalyāṃ jīvānāṃ bhagavaddāsatvaprakaraṇaṃ nāma pañcamaprameyam || 5 || atha jīvānāṃ tāratamyam aṇucaitanyarūpatvajñānitvādyaviśeṣataḥ | sāmye satyapi jīvānāṃ tāratamyaṃ ca sādhanāta|| 1 || tatrāṇutvamuktaṃ śvetāśvataraiḥ -- bālāgraśatabhāgasya śatadhā kalpitasya ca | bhāgo jīvaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sa cānantyāya kalpate || || caitanyarūpatvaṃ jñānitvādikaṃ ca ṣaṭpraśnyāṃ -- eṣa hi draṣṭā spraṣṭā śrotā ghrātā rasayitā mantā boddhā kartā vijñānātmā puruṣaḥ || || ādinā guṇena dehavyāpitvaṃ ca, śrīgītāsu -- yathā prakāśayatyekaḥ kṛtsnaṃ lokamimaṃ raviḥ | kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata || || āha caiva sūtrakāraḥ -- guṇādvālokavata|| || guṇanityatvamuktaṃ vājasaneyibhiḥ -- avināśī vā are ayamātmānucchittidharmā || || evaṃ sāmye'pi vaiṣamyamaihikaṃ karmabhiḥ sphuṭam | prāhuḥ pāratrikaṃ tattu bhaktibhedaiḥ sukovidaḥ || 2 || tathā hi kauthumāḥ paṭhanti -- yathākraturasminloke puruṣo bhavati | tathetaḥ pretya bhavati || iti || || smṛtiśca -- yādṛśī bhāvanā yasya siddhirbhavati tādṛśī || iti || || śāntyādyā ratiparyantā ye bhāvāḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ | tairdevaṃ smaratāṃ puṃsāṃ tāratamyaṃ mitho matam || 3 || iti prameyaratnāvalyāṃ jīvatāratamyaprakaraṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaprameyaṃ ||6|| kṛṣṇaprāptirūpamokṣam atha śrīkṛṣṇaprāptermokṣatvam | yathā -- jñātvā devaṃ sarvapāśāpahāniḥ || ityādi || eko vaśī sarvagaḥ kṛṣṇa īḍyam || ityādi ca || bahudhā bahubhirveśairbhāti kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | tamiṣṭvā tatpade nitye sukhaṃ tiṣṭhanti mokṣinaḥ || 1 || iti prameyaratnāvalyāṃ kṛṣṇaprāptirūpamokṣaprakaraṇaṃ nāma saptamaprameyam || 7 || viśuddhabhaktermuktipradatvam athaikāntabhaktermokṣahetutvam | yathā śrīgopālatāpanyām -- bhatkirasya bhajanaṃ tadihāmutropādhinairāsyenāmuṣminmanaḥkalpanametadeva naiṣkarmyam || || nāradapañcarātre ca -- sarvopādhivinirmuktaṃ tatparatvena nirmalam | hṛṣīkeṇa hṛṣīkeśasevanaṃ bhaktirucyate || || navadhā caiṣā bhavati | yaduktaṃ śrībhāgavate -- śravanaṃ kīrtanaṃ viṣṇoḥ smaraṇaṃ pādasevanam | arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam || iti puṃsārpitā viṣṇau bhaktiścennavalakṣaṇā | kriyate bhagavatyaddhā tanmanye'dhītamuttamam || || satsevā gurusevā ca devabhāvena cedbhaveta| tadaiṣā bhagavadbhaktirlabhyate nānyathā kvacita|| 1 || devabhāvena satsevā yathā taittirīyake -- atithidevo bhava || || tayā tadbhaktir, yathā śrībhāgavate -- naiṣāṃ matistāvadurukramāṅghriṃ spṛṣatyanarthāpagamo yadarthaḥ | mahīyasāṃ pādarajo'bhiṣekaṃ niṣkiñcanānāṃ na vṛṇīta yāvata|| || devabhāvena gurusevā yathā taittirīyake -- ācāryadevo bhava || || śvetāśvataropaniṣadi ca -- yasya deve parā bhaktiryathā deve tathā gurau | tasyaite kathitā hyarthāḥ prakāśante mahātmanaḥ || || tayā tadbhaktir, yathā śrībhāgavate -- tasmādguruṃ prapadyeta jijñāsuḥ śreya uttamam | śābde pare ca niṣṇātaṃ brahmaṇyupaśamāśrayam || tatra bhāgavatāndharmānśikṣedgurvātmadaivataḥ | amāyayā.anuvṛttyā yaistuṣyedātmātmado hariḥ || || avāptapañcasaṃskāro labdhadvividhabhaktikaḥ | sākṣātkṛtya hariṃ tasya dhāmni nityaṃ pramodate || 2 || tatra pañca saṃskārā yathā smṛtau -- tāpaḥ puṇḍraṃ tathā nāma mantro yāgaśca pañcamaḥ | amī hi pañca saṃskārāḥ paramaikāntihetavaḥ || || tāpo'tra taptacakrādimudrādhāraṇamucyate | tenaiva harināmādimudrā cāpyupalakṣyate || 3 || sā yathā smṛtau -- harināmākṣarairgātramaṅkayeccandanādinā | sa lokapāvano bhūtvā tasya lokamavāpnuyāta|| || puṇḍraṃ syādūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ tacchāstre bahuvidhaṃ smṛtam | harimandiratatpādākṛtyādyatiśubhāvaham || nāmātra gaditaṃ sadbhirharibhṛtyatvabodhakam | mantro'ṣṭādaśavarṇādiḥ sveṣṭadevavapurmataḥ || śālagrāmādipūjā tu yāgaśabdena kathyate | pramāṇānyeṣu dṛśyāni purāṇādiṣu sādhubhiḥ || 4 || navadhā bhaktirvidhirucipūrvā dvedhā bhavedyayā kṛṣṇaḥ | bhūtvā svayaṃ prasanno dadāti tattadīpsitaṃ dhāma || 5 || vidhinābhyarcyate devaścaturbāhvādirūpadhṛka| rucyātmakena tenāsau nṛliṅgaḥ paripūjyate || 6 || tulasyaśvatthadhātryādipūjanaṃ dhāmaniṣṭhatā | aruṇodayaviddhastu santyājyo harivāsaraḥ | janmāṣṭamyādikaṃ sūryodayaviddhaṃ parityajeta|| 7 || lokasaṅgrahamanvicchannityanaimittikaṃ budhaḥ | pratiṣṭhitaścaretkarma bhaktiprādhānyamatyajana|| 8 || daśa nāmāparādhāṃstu yatnataḥ parivarjayeta|| 9 || kṛṣṇāvāptiphalā bhaktirekāntātrābhidhīyate | jñānavairāgyapūrvā sā phalaṃ sadyaḥ prakāśayeta|| 10 || iti prameyaratnāvalyāṃ viśuddhabhaktermuktipradatvaprakaraṇaṃ nāma aṣṭamaprameyam ||8|| pramāṇatritvam atha pratyakṣānumānaśabdānāmeva pramāṇatvam | yathā śrībhāgavate -- śrutiḥ pratyakṣamaitihyamanumānaṃ catuṣṭayam || || pratyakṣe'ntarbhavedyasmādaitihyaṃ tena deśikaḥ | pramāṇaṃ trividhaṃ prākhyattatra mukhyā śrutirbhaveta|| 1 || pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca yatsācivyena śuddhimata| māyāmuṇḍāvalokādau pratyakṣaṃ vyabhicāri yata|| 2 || anumā cātidhūme'drau vṛṣṭinirvāpitāgnike | ataḥ pramāṇaṃ tattacca svatantraṃ naiva sammatam || 3 || anukūlo matastarkaḥ śuṣkastu parivarjitaḥ || 4 || tathā hi vājasaneyinaḥ -- ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ || || kāṭhakāḥ -- naiṣā tarkeṇa matirāpaneyā proktānyena sujñānāya preṣṭha || || smṛtiśca -- pūrvāparāvirodhena ko'trārtho'bhimato bhaveta| ityādyamūhanaṃ tarkaḥ śuṣkatarkaṃ tu varjayeta|| || nāvedaviduṣāṃ yasmādbrahmadhīrupajāyate | yaccaupaniṣadaṃ brahma tasmānmukhyā śrutirmatā || 5 || tathā hi śrutiḥ nāvedavinmanute taṃ bṛhantam || iti || aupaniṣadaṃ puruṣaṃ pṛcchāmi || || iti prameyaratnāvalyāṃ pramāṇatritvaprakaraṇaṃ nāma navamaprameyam || 9 || evamuktaṃ prācā -- śrīmadhvamate hariḥ paratamaḥ satyaṃ jagattattvato bhedo jīvagaṇā hareranucarā nīcoccabhāvaṃ gatāḥ | muktirnaijasukhānubhūtiramalā bhaktiśca tatsādhanam akṣāditritayaṃ pramāṇamakhilāmnāyaikavedyo hariḥ || 1 || ānandatīrthai racitāni yasyāṃ prameyaratnāni navaiva santi | prameyaratnāvalirādareṇa pradhībhireṣā hṛdaye nidheyā || 2 || nityaṃ nivasatu hṛdaye caitanyātmā murārirnaḥ | niravadyo nirvṛtimāngajapatiranukampayā yasya || 3 || iti śrībhagavatkṛṣṇacaitanyasampradāyācāryaśrīmadbaladevavidyābhūṣaṇakṛtā prameyaratnāvalī pūrtimagāta| samāpto'yaṃ granthaḥ
